programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Chanteclair charme toutes les poules, Carmen comprise, et les emmène à « Chantepoule ». Mais c'est un piège orchestré avec Rattila et Chanteclair ! Plus tard, Coquenpâte est enlevé par une aile volante. En le suivant, Carmen, Carmélito et Bélino rencontrent Léonard de Vinci… qui trouve enfin l'inspiration !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Si Christophe Colomb découvre l'Amérique, c'est aussi grâce à Coda, qui change accidentellement le cap. Chargé d'une lettre pour Napoléon, il cause sans le vouloir la défaite française à Waterloo. Il est aussi mêlé au naufrage du Titanic, puis vole une orange dans un souk, déclenchant une poursuite… jusqu'à l'amour avec une danseuse du ventre.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Dans le New York des années 30, Coda travaille sur l'Empire State Building, un job périlleux où il risque tout. À Babylone, il tente l'ascension de la tour de Babel pour se rapprocher de sa planète, mais le sommet reste hors d'atteinte. En pleine croisade, il échappe aux flèches des deux camps, puis en 1789, il pousse la foule à la Révolution !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Au XVIIIe siècle, poursuivi par des gardes, Coda est sauvé par des mousquetaires mais doit se déguiser en femme pour échapper à ses poursuivants. Sur la route 66, il inspire Hendrix mais se fait un ennemi. À la Zone 51, il tente de s'évader avec l'alien de Roswell. Capturé par des Vikings, il affronte loups et rivière, toujours en fuite !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Fuyant une gorgone, Coda s'écrase chez Léonard de Vinci, qui pourrait inventer une soucoupe pour lui. Après plusieurs vies perdues à tester ses inventions, Coda trouve refuge dans l'art. En Russie, il sauve Raspoutine. Dans un western, il affronte un bandit sans savoir tirer. Traqué par des morts-vivants, il se réfugie chez un vampire. Coda survivra-t-il ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Après une visite au musée, Pétunia rêve d'être paléontologue. Grabouillon, sûr de ses talents, découvre un « Grabouillontosaure », une civilisation lilliputienne et un temple maudit… enfin, un placard à ranger ! Pétunia écrit une rédaction sur lui, aidée de Cunégonde. Fatigué de ses devoirs, Grabouillon tente un problème de maths avec Bagou. Puis il perd le drone… qu'il avait pris !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Un matin, Pétunia veut emmener Grabouillon en classe. Bagou lui fait peur mais l'école est cool, trop tard, Grabouillon a raté sa chance ! Il organise alors une photo de classe, sans permission, catastrophe assurée. Pour le spectacle de danse il prend des cours mais c'est du western, pas du ballet. Enfin il tente de rapporter le cartable de Pétunia, aidé de ses amis mais oublie son sac de danse !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon veut partir en classes de neige avec Pétunia, mais il n'est pas invité. Il tente de l'en empêcher, puis comprend sa déception. En aidant Pétunia, il fait tomber son livre d'histoire à l'eau et essaie d'en fabriquer un faux. Avec Bagou, ils perdent son stylo fétiche qui donne vie aux dessins. Enfin, Grabouillon prépare un déjeuner surprise, mais ça tourne au pique-nique !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon et Bagou font du kart dans le jardin, mais les enfants rentrent tôt, privés de karts. Pétunia leur apprend le code de la route. Pendant un week-end chez sa mamie, Grabouillon doit subir Gladys en baby-sitter. Pour venger Pétunia, il défie Gladys aux billes, mais perd la dernière bille avalée par Bagou. Quand Grabouillon attrape des poux, il tente de les refiler à Pétunia… en vain !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Frou-Frou est maussade et trouve tout « nul ». Ses amis s'inquiètent, mais Lulu a une idée : partir à la chasse au trésor de l'arc-en-ciel après la pluie. Pendant ce temps, une branche du vieux cerisier a cassé sous la neige, et Brico interdit l'accès. Pourtant, Blaise doit absolument récupérer un trésor secret là-bas !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Pour la fête de l'école, Lulu écrit un poème sur la nature. La maîtresse propose de le mettre en musique, mais les amis ont du mal à s'accorder. Pour la nuit des étoiles filantes, Frou-Frou fait semblant d'être en danger pour attirer Blaise. Après deux sauvetages, la troisième fois, personne ne la croit alors qu'elle est vraiment en danger.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Rien-Ne-Sert perd la montre que Lulu lui a prêtée. Pour cacher cela, il fait croire qu'il a perdu la mémoire. Ses amis s'activent pour l'aider, mais RNS comprend que mentir n'est pas la solution. Pendant ce temps, ils tournent un film de pirates, Lulu joue la princesse et RNS regrette de ne pas avoir participé.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Stupeur dans le potager : les citrouilles n'ont pas poussé pour Halloween ! Lulu et ses copains enquêtent. Par ailleurs, Lulu ne croit pas aux sorcières. Pour lui faire une farce, Rien-Ne-Sert lui fait croire qu'une sorcière rôde dans la forêt, surtout quand la lune est rousse…

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Brico apprend aux amis que jeter une pièce dans le lavoir exauce les vœux. Tous croient en la magie sauf Lulu. Pour la convaincre, ils tentent de réaliser un vœu en secret, mais ça tourne mal. Pendant ce temps, Lulu prépare un cadeau pour la maîtresse : des tulipes. Mais son cadeau disparaît. Avec Rien-Ne-Sert, elle enquête pour retrouver le voleur.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E26 Pingu et l'abominable homme des neiges | Pingu Boogaloo | Pingu et l'avion à élastiques
programme.desc: S2:E26 Pingu et l'abominable homme des neiges | Pingu Boogaloo | Pingu et l'avion à élastiques - Pingu veut faire croire à Pinga qu'un abominable homme des neiges est en liberté en Antarctique. | Pingu entend une nouvelle chanson à la radio et n'arrive pas à s'en lasser. | L'ami de Pingu apporte un avion à élastique à l'école et Pingu remplace l'élastique pour que l'avion vole plus loin.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: S3:E1 Épisode 1 - Pingu prépare un festin ! | Attention où tu mets les pieds, Pingu ! | Les règles de baby-sitting de Pingu

programme.title: Pingu

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: On passe à la télé
programme.desc: Un producteur très influent veut transposer iCarly à la télévision. Mais Carly, Sam et Freddie sont vite décontenancés par les changements que le producteur veut opérer dans l'émission...

programme.title: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: L'homme du Minnesota
programme.desc: Emprisonné à tort pour un crime qu'il n'a pas commis, Minnesota Clay cherche à se venger de l'homme qui a dissimulé des preuves lors de son procès. Le hic : il devient aveugle.

programme.title: Le Retour de Sabata
programme.desc: Les citoyens de Hobsonville engagent Sabata pour les débarrasser du clan McIntock, qui les taxe de force et illégalement sous le prétexte du développement de la ville.

programme.title: Le colt du révérend
programme.desc: Le pasteur Miller arrive à Tucson, mais le jour même de son arrivée, une bande de malfaiteurs braque la banque, et les habitants l'accusent d'être l'auteur du braquage.

programme.title: Aujourd'hui ma peau, demain la tienne
programme.desc: Le suave joueur Clay Watson, l'arrogant tireur d'élite Moses Lang et le rusé comédien Edwin Kean forment un trio de criminels dans le vieil Ouest.

programme.title: Arriva Sabata…
programme.desc: Sabata et Mangosta sont des braqueurs de banque qui, après un cambriolage, se retrouvent, à la suite d'une série d'événements, à faire équipe avec Peter, un employé de banque.

programme.title: Blue, mon chien d'Australie
programme.desc: Une histoire australienne emblématique de la famille, de l'amitié et de l'aventure, entre un jeune garçon et un chien rustique unique en son genre qui deviendra une légende australienne.

programme.title: Tom Sawyer et Huckleberry Finn
programme.desc: Tom Sawyer et son ami Huckleberry Finn s'embarquent pour une incroyable aventure sur le fleuve Mississipi, se prenant pour des pirates, assistant à leurs propres funérailles puis devenant témoins d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Dragon Girl
programme.desc: Dans le petit village de Borington, tout le monde se prépare à fêter Noël. Sauf Sara, une réfugiée de 10 ans cachée dans une maison abandonnée. Un dragon s'y réfugie aussi, et Mortimer découvre la fillette et la créature.

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Urban Country
programme.desc: Une adolescente de la ville décide d'aller passer l'été au ranch familial dans une petite ville du sud pour s'occuper de sa mère malade.

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: Un tueur professionnel, hanté par des visions de son sanglant passé, perd le contrôle. Son travail est compromis lorsqu'il atteint un point de non retour, et qu'il se retrouve forcé de défendre sa famille contre ses propres employeurs…

programme.title: Sous nos pieds
programme.desc: Des immigrés clandestins sautent sur l'opportunité de faire des travaux dans la maison d'une riche américaine, mais le rêve se transforme bien vite au cauchemar quand la femme qu'ils croyaient être une patronne comme les autres révèle son véritable visage…

programme.title: The Fanatic
programme.desc: Moose est fan de cinéma et obsédé par son acteur préféré, Hunter Dunbar. Prêt à tout pour rencontrer son idole, Moose passe du fan au fanatique quand il se met, malgré ses bonnes intentions, à persécuter l'acteur…

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Lors d'une émission en direct, un célèbre animateur radio est pris en otage par des hommes armés déterminés à révéler un secret compromettant. Une nuit de suspense où sa carrière et sa vie sont en jeu.

programme.title: Plaine orientale
programme.desc: C'est le printemps. Dans la Plaine Orientale Corse, la récolte des fruits bat son plein. De nombreux travailleurs venus de loin y trouvent un emploi pour la saison. Mathilde, une jeune cueilleuse de pomelos, évolue entre les deux équipes de son patron. D'un côté, des Européens, de l'autre, des Maghrébins.

programme.title: Truth or Consequences
programme.desc: Truth or Consequences est une ville du Nouveau-Mexique. Ronan Guillou en a fait une étape de ses investigations photographiques américaines. En mêlant photos, son et textes il nous propose ici un portrait sensible de la ville et de ses habitants.

programme.title: Du vent dans les épaules
programme.desc: Si vous dîtes à votre médecin “j'ai un peu de vent dans les épaules”, il va vous regarder de travers... Mais pour un chinois, c'est absolument évident !

programme.title: Gamin
programme.desc: Un gamin, Paulo, bricole sa voiture, une Peugeot 205 toit ouvrant, aidé par ses potes, pour aller retrouver son père, un père pas vu, plus vu depuis des années. Un père qu'il n'en peut plus d'espérer.

programme.title: La Cinémamecque
programme.desc: La Cinémamecque est une série de courts métrages en stop motion, une histoire du cinéma modelée, animée et analysée et un ciné-club.

programme.title: L'Homme des bois
programme.desc: Jean Douchet à la Cinématek présente L'Homme des bois et la philosophie d'Henry David Thoreau.

programme.title: Le Terrier
programme.desc: Le Terrier est le dernier texte de Kafka, un monologue vertigineux en forme d'adresse, laissé inachevé. Planches dépareillées et palettes de guingois plantées en intérieur en seront le terrain, Strike le corps, lecteur, interprète et protagoniste. Du terrier-lieu au terrier-texte.

programme.title: Les cœurs vaillants
programme.desc: Jo, J.G. et Daniel, amis d'enfance, ont monté un groupe de rock, “Les Coeurs Vaillants”. Ils se rendent à leur tout premier concert.

programme.title: Sœur et frère
programme.desc: Une jeune fille vit une relation très complice avec son frère aîné.

programme.title: Mal de terre
programme.desc: Un marin russe revient en ville après un très long voyage.

programme.title: Écart de conduite
programme.desc: Pour la neuvième fois, Chloé tente de passer son permis de conduire.

programme.title: Masques
programme.desc: Deux masques se font face sous une multitude de regards inquiétants. Un signal est donné, commence alors une danse, un combat rituel.

programme.title: L'homme d'à côté
programme.desc: Film sur François Truffaut, l'amour et le cinéma.

programme.title: La fin du dragon
programme.desc: Marianne, Mike et Angèle sont réunis autour de leur mère. D'ici dix jours, après l'arrêt des machines qui la maintiennent dans le coma, Claudine sera morte. Dix jours ? Marianne n'avait pas compris que ça durerait tant…

programme.title: Blinis !
programme.desc: Eva, Manon et Garance se retrouvent la veille de Noël pour préparer des blinis selon l'authentique recette de leur grand-mère russe. Entre chants et danses, rires et pleurs, féérie de Noël et réalité sociale, les affinités évoluent au fil des sujets abordés.

programme.title: Fukushima, 5 ans après
programme.desc: Cinq ans après l'accident nucléaire qui a touché la préfecture de Fukushima, la vie continue pour les habitants.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Un soir enneigé, Fred, trentenaire fatigué, rencontre un étrange individu.

programme.title: Escale
programme.desc: Deux femmes se font face. Deux chemins se croisent.

programme.title: Je suis orientée
programme.desc: Une adolescente passe un entretien pour faire le choix de son futur métier.

programme.title: Scintillant dans l'ombre
programme.desc: Hervé, un chauffeur routier solitaire, transporte une mystérieuse caisse jusqu'à un parc zoologique. Quelque chose ne tourne pas rond avec sa cargaison.

programme.title: Les cowboys n'ont pas peur de mourir
programme.desc: Que Valence et Michel attaquent une diligence, c'est normal. Que Valence en revienne avec une balle dans le ventre, c'est pas étonnant. Mais quand la vie met des heures et des heures à quitter son corps de cow-boy, là, y a maldonne.

programme.title: Groove your life
programme.desc: Groove your life, société spécialisée dans le bonheur à domicile, vous propose de remédier à toutes vos névroses! Tout est possible, il vous suffit de le décider et surtout de nous téléphoner! 2 euros 50 la minute plus frais supplémentaires selon opérateur.

programme.title: Baby Rush
programme.desc: Alors qu'Orleans vit à l'heure du marathon, Jackie, athlétique trentenaire américaine est dans les starting blocks : 3,2,1... Partez ! Jackie s'élance, elle est prête à surmonter tous les obstacles pour atteindre son objectif : faire un enfant avec Jérôme, aujourd'hui !

programme.title: Un métier bien
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle vit ses derniers instants, Hakim promet à sa mère qu'il va changer, devenir un autre homme, et trouver, enfin, un métier bien.

programme.title: Yo! Pekin
programme.desc: Le groupe de pop-rappée franco-californien Naive New Beaters crée le buzz en Chine avec une video de danse « Quan Chang Wu » tournée devant la tour Eiffel. Invités par les autorités, David Boring et ses acolytes atterrissent dans la ferveur et la pollution du pays du panda. Mais très vite, leur périple vire au drame diplomatico-politique. Yo! Pekin, le premier « docu-fiction-film d'action-film de vacances »

programme.title: Le commissaire perdrix ne fait pas le voyage pour rien
programme.desc: Anselmini, ancien truand, est un homme seul mais libre. Cette liberté, c'est précisément ce que sont venus prendre le Commissaire Perdrix et le Lieutenant Webb, deux flics perdus dans un pays, dans une temporalité qui ne sont pas les leurs.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Jack Quinn, l'un des meilleurs agents spéciaux antiterroristes à la retraite, coule des jours heureux avec sa compagne en attendant leur premier enfant. Jusqu'au jour où la réapparition de Stavros, son ennemi juré, l'oblige à repartir en mission...

programme.title: SuperGrid
programme.desc: Dans un avenir où une peste a infecté une grande partie de la population deux frères sont chargés de se rendre au Canada pour récupérer un mystérieux colis.

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d'adolescents en vacances au bord d'une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes. Pour rester en vie ils vont devoir se confronter aux castors zombies qui les attaquent dans leurs propres cabines...

programme.title: Voyage Au Centre De La Terre
programme.desc: Un appareil de forage high-tech est créé pour sauver une équipe de chercheurs piégée très profondément sous la surface de la terre. Ces chercheurs avaient découvert quelque temps plus tôt une faune spectaculaire, des créatures extraordinaires et des animaux préhistoriques.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un commando d'élite de l'armée américaine tend une embuscade à des rebelles, le professeur Lovecraft guide plusieurs de ses élèves dans une mission archéologique. Une étudiante est attaquée par un ptérodactyle.

programme.title: Black sea
programme.desc: Récemment renvoyé par sa société, un capitaine de sous-marin est embauché pour trouver un trésor gisant au fond de la mer.

programme.title: Les cinq gentlemen maudits
programme.desc: A Tanger, un sorcier prédit, à cinq amis, une mort certaine et rapide. Trois d'entre eux auront déjà trouvé la mort quand les deux autres résoudront l'énigme.

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: Goldmoon, une société écran qui abrite un syndicat du crime, vient de perdre son président et parrain. La succession est proche, et trois hommes vont livrer bataille pour accéder au trOne. Parmi eux, un flic infiltré depuis 10 ans veut profiter de ce changement pour sortir du syndicat et reprendre une vie normale. Mais comme la police a encore besoin de ses services et que ses concurrents au trOne mènent une enquête sur une potentielle taupe, il va devoir faire un choix: rester dans l'organisation criminelle, ou en sortir.

programme.title: J'aurais Voulu Etre Un Danseur
programme.desc: François mène une vie paisible et heureuse avec sa ravissante épouse et son jeune fils jusquà ce qu'il découvre pour la première fois la comédie musicale "Singin' in the rain". Hypnotisé, il quitte sa famille pour se consacrer à sa nouvelle et dévorante passion pour les claquettes. Mais il ne sait pas encore que son père et son grand-père ont fait la même chose des années auparavant...

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes & John Watson
programme.desc: Les frangins malgré eux se retrouvent. Cette fois, ils interprètent le plus grand détective du monde et son fidèle acolyte et biographe. Will Ferrell et John C. Reilly jouent Holmes et Watson. Ensemble, ils élucident un meurtre à Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Clean, un homme au passé criminel, cherche la rédemption après avoir vécu une tragédie personnelle. Il dédie désormais sa vie à sa communauté délaissée et à la sécurité d'une jeune fille qui lui rappelle sa propre fille.

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Après la disparition de son amie à Tijuana, Gloria Meyer se retrouve au centre d'un jeu dangereux joué par la CIA, la DEA et un chef de gang.

programme.title: Représailles : La traque sauvage
programme.desc: Une femme, ancienne militaire, pourchasse les hommes qui ont enlevé son fils. Elle prend tous les risques pour parvenir à le tirer des griffes des ravisseurs.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Imaginez que vous viviez dans une petite ville paisible et heureuse... jusqu'au jour où la situation bascule. Dans ce récit terrifiant du "rêve américain" qui tourne mal, quatre habitants d'Ogden Marsh, dans l'État d'Alabama, se retrouvent piégés dans leur ville natale.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: Tard le soir de Noël, une femme qui sort seule du travail est enlevée par un agent de sécurité psychopathe qui a une obsession pour elle. Sans personne pour l'aider dans un parking immense, elle ne pourra compter que sur elle-même pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: Une épidémie inconnue a transformé la population mondiale en vampires et les rares humains restants sont capturés et élevés pour leur sang. Mais alors que les réserves de sang sont presque épuisées les vampires commencent à se battre entre eux et à se nourrir les uns des autres.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Imaginez que vous viviez dans une petite ville paisible et heureuse... jusqu'au jour où la situation bascule. Dans ce récit terrifiant du "rêve américain" qui tourne mal, quatre habitants d'Ogden Marsh, dans l'État d'Alabama, se retrouvent piégés dans leur ville natale.

programme.title: Terre Maudite
programme.desc: Une femme des plaines fait face à la dureté et à l'isolement de la terre sauvage de la frontière occidentale de la fin des années 1800.

programme.title: 119 Jours : Les Survivants De Locean
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de quatre hommes, ayant vécu l'enfer durant 119 jours au beau milieu de l'océan Pacifique, après que leur trimaran, le Rose Noelle, ait chaviré au cours d'une tempête en 1989.

programme.title: Frankie et Johnny
programme.desc: Love story moderne où lui (Al Pacino) travaille dans un restaurant grec après un bref séjour en prison et elle (Michelle Pfeiffer), serveuse dans le même restaurant, refuse toute relation sentimentale...

programme.desc: À la mort de leur père, deux sœurs jusque-là très gâtées doivent quitter les beaux quartiers pour aller vivre chez leur tante, dans un quartier latino de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Une Affaire d'amour
programme.desc: Mauvais timing : Thomas débarque à l'improviste chez son ex-copine, Sarah Pohl, une journaliste en pleine enquête sur des sans-papiers.

programme.title: Quelqu'un Que J'ai Bien Connu
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage dans sa ville natale, Ally (Alison Brie), une bourreau de travail, passe une nuit tourbillonnante avec son ex-petit ami Sean (Jay Ellis), ce qui l'amène à remettre en question tous les choix qu'elle a faits et la personne qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que
programme.desc: Une tragédie apprend au jeune homme d'affaires anglais Ian Wyndham à faire passer l'amour avant le travail. Il apprend enfin à s'ouvrir à sa petite amie Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: Flirt et Passe-Passe
programme.desc: Des jumelles identiques, Alice et Lacey, sont prises l'une pour l'autre lors d'une retraite. Elles décident de jouer le jeu le temps du séjour, mais réalisent bientôt qu'elles se sont peut-être trompées sur ce dont elles avaient réellement besoin dans leur vie.

programme.title: Sur la ligne
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, la jeune et talentueuse Anna est sélectionnée pour la formation spéciale et secrète des jeux Olympiques dans la catégorie Sprint. Prête à tout pour gagner cette compétition, elle n'échappera pas à l'engrenage du dopage.

Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Le Dr. Marissa Blumenthal enquête sur la propagation d'un terrible virus qui s'abat sur Los Angeles. La jeune femme est persuadée que l'épidémie est le fruit d'un acte criminel.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: The Cake Eaters: Absolution in Love

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur

programme.desc: Stacy, une jeune journaliste en herbe, découvre, en regardant dans l'organizer électronique de son petit ami, qu'il a eu avant elle une suite de relations sentimentales incroyables avec, entre autres, un superbe mannequin et la voisine de palier. Elle décide de toutes les rencontrer...

programme.title: Potins De Femmes
programme.desc: Dans la ville imaginaire de Chinquapin, en Louisiane, un mariage se prépare. La mariée s'appelle Shelby (Julia Roberts), une belle jeune femme têtue dont la mère très stricte, M'Lynn (Sally Field), est prête à tout pour elle. Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.title: Still Crazy
programme.desc: Wisbech 1977. Strange Fruit, le groupe de rock britannique, jette ses derniers feux. Entre les chamailleries mesquines et les coups bas en coulisses et sur scene, le groupe se dissout. Ibiza 1997. Tony, l'ancien clavier, reconverti en fournisseur de preservatifs sur l'ile, rencontre par hasard le fils du promoteur de Wisbech qui lui propose de reformer le groupe pour un concert, Wisbech 1998.

programme.title: Miss Campus
programme.desc: Arrivée dans l'université de South Atlantic, Sydney White ne que rentrer dans la prestigieuse confrérie féminine fondée par sa défunte mère. Mais elle découvre que ce club a évolué pour le pire sous la férule de la narcissique et cruelle Rachel. Dégoûtée de cet avilissement elle quitte la fraternité, mais se retrouve du même coup à la rue. Elle trouve alors refuge dans la maison d'un groupe de septs exclus de sa faculté, avec lesquels elle va ourdir un plan pour briser la mainmise de Rachel sur le campus et redonner leur dignité aux laissés-pour-compte du campus. Une version moderne et décalée de Blanche-Neige et les sept nains.

programme.title: Art School Confidential
programme.desc: Passionné par le dessin depuis son enfance, le jeune Jérome s'inscrit dans une école d'art, à Strathmore. Alors qu'il apprend peu à peu comment fonctionne le monde des artistes, un tueur en série va semer la panique au sein de l'établissement.

programme.title: Ruth & Alex
programme.desc: Ruth et Alex, un couple new-yorkais, voient leur quotidien bouleversé lorsqu'ils sont contraints de vendre leur appartement de brooklyn dans lequel ils ont vécu de nombreuses années.

programme.title: 5 fantômes en terminale
programme.desc: On ne peut pas vraiment dire que Modesto fait figure de modèle de sociabilité. Même à l'époque des boums, le garçon avait déjà tendance à rester dans son coin. Autant dire que les choses ne se sont pas arrangées depuis qu'il s'est découvert une faculté pour voir et communiquer avec les fantômes.

programme.title: Mon beauf, ma sœur et moi

Peu de temps après avoir emménagé, Lisa a d'étranges visions et se rend compte que sa sinistre nouvelle amie n'est autre que le fantôme de la jumelle morte de sa maman. La mort d'un étudiant retrouvé congelé va accentuer les soupçons du jeune homme quant à la véritable identité de ces nouvelles étudiantes.

Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

Launched in January of 2025, the campaign aims to tackle misconceptions surrounding a HIV diagnosis in order to help reduce the stigma experienced by people living with HIV across Ireland.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions

From completely missing the mark to unexpectedly clutch answers, the episode is full of laughs as they attempt to decode Gen Z slang, test how well they know each other, and recall legendary Sidemen moments.

programme.title: Labour's Local Election Wipeout Analysed
programme.desc: Laura and Seán analyse the 2026 local elections, examining the winners and losers as Labour's poor form continues. Reform achieved significant gains with a landslide in councils across the country, whilst the Greens made notable wins in Hackney and Edinburgh. In Wales, Labour's First Minister failed to gain reelection as the party's troubles deepen. The question remains whether Keir Starmer can survive.

programme.title: The Cliff Diver and The Egomaniac
programme.desc: The world-renowned matchmaker, Patti Stanger, is back and upping her matchmaking game! Along with her team of love gurus, Patti takes over the Luxe Hotel in Los Angeles where she will practice her toughest love yet to break the most challenging clients of their bad dating habits as they vie for true love. Checking into the Millionaire's Club for the week are two, polar opposite bachelors and best buds from The Bachelor: the cliff diver, Vinny Ventiera and the ultimate narcissist, Daniel Maguire. Unbeknownst to the millionaires, Patti's eyes and ears are everywhere! Before being fixed up, Daniel must go through one of Patti's love lessons to shock him out of his bad boy behavior. Daniel keeps his expectations high and his compliments low, but is blindsided when Patti gives him a shocking first impression rose! Meanwhile, Patti must get Vinny to learn how to ‘qualify his buyer' before cliff diving into the wrong relationship. Patti and her team of love experts recruit sexy singles for the bachelors but things turn left during the mingle when a fan girl leaves Vinny for Daniel! Though the millionaires get to choose who to take out, Patti decides to strategize a special date, specifically designed to break the bromance and spark romance. But when Patti's rules are broken, who will get the wrath of the no-nonsense matchmaker? In the end, will the daters accept Vinny and Daniel's final rose or will the bachelors check out heartbroken and alone?

programme.title: Devina A.D.D. & The Relationship Virgin
programme.desc: It's a new week at the Millionaire's Club and that means two tough new clients for matchmaker, Patti Stanger. Author Devina Kaur is a sex crazed dating addict who's obsessed with hooking up with men on Craigslist. And Peter Curti, a gay millennial entrepreneur with his head buried in his phone, has never had a real relationship. Devina proves to be a challenge right out of the gate, matching Patti scream for scream. All of her outbursts leave Patti wondering if Devina has come to the Millionaire's Club just because she's run out of men on the internet. And when Patti throws a test into the mingle, Devina A.D.D. unsurprisingly fails miserably and earns a matchmaker punishment. It's a crap-shoot whether this wild and crazy Canadian will finally listen to Patti and find true love or revert to searching Craigslist for men. Meanwhile, relationship virgin Peter, is thrown into his love lesson. When confronted with his anti-social behavior, he argues with Patti, even telling her she's too old to understand. A generation gap Is obvious but Patti knows that dealing with millennials and their tech obsession requires an adjustment in tactics. Peter needs to learn to ditch his phone, pull his eyes up and learn to approach men like an alpha or he'll end up alone!

programme.title: Mr. Build-A-Girl and The Basketball Wife
programme.desc: This week it's a full-on, knock-down, drag-out fight between Patti Stanger and her two combative clients! Tough girl Basketball Wives LA tv star, Laura Govan, was majorly burned by her NBA star boyfriend of 17 years. Their nasty and highly publicized breakup left Laura alone with their four kids and with major trust issues. Patti's hidden cameras catch Laura in the act of some shocking behaviors that Laura uses to keep men away from her heart. If Laura wants to find a good man and potential stepfather to her four kids, she has to change her offensive deflecting behavior, or she'll remain single. Meanwhile, Bastian Yotta is obsessed with working out, his good looks and wants a woman who is equally as “perfect”. Patti calls Bastian out for being a “build-a-girl” after discovering that he will do will do anything to improve a woman's looks, even suggest and pay for their surgical enhancements. His superficial mentality prevents chemistry from taking over and Patti is forced give him one of her toughest reality checks ever to try and shake him of his perfectionism. At the mingle, it's Patti vs Bastian in a heated altercation after he insults the looks of one of her daters. And Laura and Bastian's dates go off the rails when one goes for a colon cleanse and the other instigates a private bikini fashion show. Both clients get the wrath of Patti, but will that be enough to help them get on the right path to true love?

programme.title: The Ageist and The Snob
programme.desc: Third generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever! She's taken over the exclusive Luxe Hotel in Bel-Air where she brings her toughest clients for a week-long lesson in love. This week, Patti is on the case with two tough lawyers: the ageist, David Goldman, and the first-class snob, Rhonda Wills. Right out of the gate, David jumps head first into a love lesson that he fails miserably when he ditches his age-appropriate date for a romp in the pool with a bunch of 20-somethings. Meanwhile, Patti struggles to convince Snobby Pants Rhonda to give up on her fairytale fantasy of Prince Charming. Patti, Candace, and Maxwell team up to find the perfect sexy singles for the mingle, but Patti throws the ageist David another curve ball when she adds a 22-year-old to the mix to test him. Will he fall for it and break Patti's rules or has he learned his lesson? Rhonda, on the other hand, meets a knight in shining armor. But… will she try to escape when he fails to deliver a fairytale first date. In the end, Patti's got a tough week. Will the lawyers learn their lesson or will it be a hung jury?

programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Darrin's parents pay their first visit to the Stephens home, Darrin's mother, Phyllis, hopes to find that his wife is a poor housekeeper. Soon after, Samantha's Aunt Clara comes down the chimney for an unexpected visit. Darrin is worried about the kind of impression Aunt Clara will make on his parents, but agrees with Samantha that they must make Aunt Clara feel welcome. Determined to help Samantha make a hit with her in-laws, Aunt Clara uses her witchcraft to whip up a feast for dinner. Thinking that Samantha has done the cooking, Phyllis becomes quite upset. Although Samantha warns him to be tactful, Darrin makes Aunt Clara feel she is not wanted. After Aunt Clara's de-parture, Samantha gets into an argument with Darrin, during which Phyllis learns Aunt Clara cooked the dinner. When Samantha admits she is not a good housekeeper, Phyllis, who felt she was being pushed aside, knows she is going to love her daughter-in-law. Darrin persuades Aunt Clare to return and the evening ends happily for all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Seven year old Tommy, who lives in an orphanage, is happy to spend Christmas with Gladys and Abner Kravitz. Six year old Michael, also an orphan, derides Tommy's belief is Santa Claus. When Samantha and Darrin bring him home for the holidays, their efforts to get Michael to share in the festivities of the season fail. After Michael admits he would believe in Santa Claus if he really existed, Samantha takes Michael and Darrin on her broomstick to the North Pole, where Michael meets Santa Claus. At the Kravitz home, both Gladys and Abner, who are about to return Tommy to the orphanage, express their wish to have someone like Tommy permanently. programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.
